notes.Nikola Jokic: Denver had no one on the official injury report this morning, so Jokic has his full starting group around him. He has played 38 to 42 minutes in Denver's last three games, and Dallas is without its starting center Dereck Lively II after foot surgery.
notes.Jamal Murray: Murray played 45 minutes on Sunday because the Chicago game went to overtime, up from 36 to 38 minutes in his games before that. Denver is fully healthy, so his role as the second option next to Jokic is unchanged in the slate's highest-total game.
notes.Cade Cunningham: Cunningham is listed as probable with right knee soreness, the same issue that cost him a game last week before he played 36 and 33 minutes since. Detroit is still without Jalen Duren and Duncan Robinson, and its rotation behind him has shrunk.
notes.Jayson Tatum: Tatum returned from a rest night on Sunday and played 38 minutes. Paul George is not on today's injury report after sitting the second night of the back-to-back, so Boston is near full strength apart from Mitchell Robinson (illness), and the 10.5-point spread brings some blowout risk.
notes.Cooper Flagg: Flagg has started every game and played 31 to 36 minutes in his last three. P.J. Washington is questionable with the illness that kept him out of Dallas's last two games, and Lively is out, so the Dallas frontcourt is thin again.
notes.Isaiah Joe: Joe has played 16, 18 and 26 minutes off the bench since joining Detroit, and the 26 came on Sunday. Duncan Robinson (quadriceps) and Jalen Duren (hamstring) are both out again, which leaves open wing and bench minutes.
notes.Zaccharie Risacher: Risacher started both games P.J. Washington missed and played 29 and 28 minutes, after only 18 off the bench on Nov. 18 when Washington played. Washington is questionable with an illness, so Risacher's role depends on that decision.
notes.Luka Garza: Mitchell Robinson is out again with an illness. Garza played 17 minutes in each of the two games Robinson missed, after only 5 minutes on Nov. 18 when Robinson played, with Neemias Queta starting at center.
notes.Tristan da Silva: Da Silva has come off the bench since Jalen Suggs returned to the lineup on Nov. 16, and he has played 24 to 27 minutes in each of his last three games. Paolo Banchero is still out, which keeps those forward minutes open.
Clayton has held a steady bench role of 21 to 27 minutes over Dallas's last three games. P.J. Washington is questionable and Lively is out, so Dallas's rotation stays short.
notes.Javonte Green: Green started on Nov. 18 and played 35 minutes, but he has been back on the bench for 23 and 18 minutes since Cade Cunningham returned. Duncan Robinson and Jalen Duren are both out again tonight.
notes.Bilal Coulibaly: Coulibaly has played 24 to 26 minutes off the bench in Washington's last three games. The Wizards have trimmed their bench to mainly Coulibaly and Khris Middleton, and Justin Champagnie, Jamir Watkins and Tristan Vukcevic are all out tonight.
notes.Sam Hauser: Hauser started Boston's last two games while Tatum, Derrick White and then Paul George sat. George is not on today's injury report, so Hauser is likely headed back to a bench role of around 17 to 22 minutes.
notes.John Collins: Collins has started at center for Detroit with Jalen Duren out, but he has played only 20 to 22 minutes in two of his last three games because Detroit uses one big at a time and splits the job with Paul Reed.
notes.Paul Reed: Reed has come off the bench for 20 to 28 minutes while Jalen Duren is out, and he out-played John Collins in minutes in two of the last three games. Duren is out again tonight.
notes.Daniss Jenkins: Jenkins has started and played 36 to 39 minutes in Detroit's last three games. Detroit is thin with Duncan Robinson and Jalen Duren out, so his minutes have been safe even on off shooting nights.
notes.Ausar Thompson: Thompson played 38 minutes on Sunday and has been at 33 or more in each of Detroit's last three games. With Detroit's rotation short behind Cade Cunningham, he is handling a big all-around role.
notes.Kevin Huerter: Huerter has started every game since Duncan Robinson went down and played 30 to 36 minutes. Isaiah Joe's 26 minutes on Sunday is the threat to watch, since Huerter scored only two points that night.
notes.Anthony Black: Black has started and played 35 to 37 minutes in Orlando's last three games with Paolo Banchero out. Banchero is out again tonight, so the ball-handling load stays with Black and Franz Wagner.
notes.Franz Wagner: Wagner has played 32 to 36 minutes in every recent game and is Orlando's main creator while Paolo Banchero is out. His minutes dipped to 32 on Sunday in a 20-point loss.
notes.Jalen Suggs: Suggs has started since returning on Nov. 16, but foul trouble held him to 22 minutes on Sunday after 30 and 31 in his previous two games.
notes.Neemias Queta: Queta has started at center and played 27 to 30 minutes in Boston's last three games. Mitchell Robinson is out again with an illness, so Queta keeps the starting job with Luka Garza as the backup.
notes.Paul George: George sat out Sunday on the second night of a back-to-back after playing 37 minutes on Saturday. He is not on today's injury report, so he should return to the starting lineup.
notes.Payton Pritchard: Pritchard went back to the bench on Sunday when Tatum and Derrick White returned, and he took only eight shots in 28 minutes. Mike Conley has re-entered Boston's rotation for 16 to 18 minutes, which takes some of his backcourt time.
notes.Daniel Gafford: Gafford played 31 and 28 minutes in the two games P.J. Washington missed, after 24 minutes on Nov. 18 when Washington played. Washington is questionable, so Gafford's minutes depend on that decision, and Dereck Lively II is still out.
notes.Aaron Gordon: Gordon has started and played 31 to 33 minutes in Denver's last three games and is healthy. Denver has no one on today's injury report.
notes.Anthony Davis: Davis has played 33 to 34 minutes in Washington's last three games and plays a lot of center because Alex Sarr has stayed in the 20s and Deandre Ayton has played 11 minutes or fewer. Tristan Vukcevic is out again tonight.
notes.AJ Dybantsa: Dybantsa has played 33 to 38 minutes in Washington's last three games as the second option behind Anthony Davis.
notes.Kyshawn George: George has played 35 to 40 minutes in Washington's last three games, one of the biggest minute loads on the team.
notes.Trae Young: Young played only 28 minutes on Sunday and sat most of the late garbage time in a 20-point game, down from 32 to 35 in the two before. He has been deferring more since AJ Dybantsa's return.
notes.Mike Conley: Conley re-entered Boston's rotation on Nov. 21 after not playing since Nov. 8, and he kept 16 minutes on Sunday even with Tatum and Derrick White back.
notes.PJ Washington: Washington is questionable with an illness after missing Dallas's last two games. When he sat, Zaccharie Risacher started and Daniel Gafford played 31 and 28 minutes.
